subject: english
title: Самые нужные глаголы
summary: 20 глаголов, без которых не построить ни одного предложения: be, have, do, go, get, make, know, want, like, need…
theory:
## Как учить эти слова
Это первые 20 из 1500 самых частых английских слов. Без этих глаголов не получится сказать почти ничего, поэтому начинаем с них.

1. **15 новых слов в день** — не больше. Остальное время — повторение по карточкам.
2. **Говори вслух**: слово, транскрипция и пример — по 3 раза.
3. **Пиши свои предложения**: 5 коротких фраз про себя (*I have a brother. I like tea.*).
4. **Встречай слова в жизни**: смотри Extra English и лови эти глаголы на слух.

## Совет: неправильные глаголы
В прошедшем времени (Past Simple) многие из этих глаголов меняются целиком. Учи их сразу парой:

| Глагол | Прошедшее |
|---|---|
| be | was / were |
| have | had |
| do | did |
| go | went |
| get | got |
| make | made |
| see | saw |
| come | came |
| give | gave |
| say | said |

Ещё: know → knew, think → thought, take → took, find → found, can → could. Правильные глаголы просто получают *-ed*: want → wanted, like → liked, look → looked. И не забывай *-s* после he / she: *he goes, she has, he does*.

words.def: a word we use to say who, what or where someone or something is
words.example: My brother is at school now.

words.def: to own something; also to eat or drink something
words.example: I have two brothers and one sister.

words.def: to work on something or act in some way
words.example: I do my homework after school.

words.def: to move from one place to another place
words.example: We go to school at eight.

words.def: to receive something; also to arrive at a place
words.example: I got a message from my friend yesterday.

words.def: to build, cook or create something new
words.example: My mother makes very good bread.

words.def: to have some information in your head
words.example: I don't know his name.

words.def: to have an idea or opinion in your head
words.example: I think this film is very good.

words.def: to put your hand on something and carry it with you
words.example: I take my phone to school every day.

words.def: to notice something with your eyes
words.example: I see my grandmother every Sunday.

words.def: to move to the place where you are or where another person is
words.example: Come to my house after school!

words.def: to wish to have or do something
words.example: I want a new phone.

words.def: to think that something or someone is nice or good
words.example: I like football and music.

words.def: to want something because it is very important for you
words.example: I need a pen for the test.

words.def: to put something in another person's hand; to let someone have it
words.example: My dad gave me a new bag for my birthday.

words.def: to speak some words
words.example: She said hello to me in the morning.

words.def: to turn your eyes to something to see it
words.example: Look at this photo!

words.def: to do something with a thing because it helps you
words.example: I use my phone for music and games.

words.def: to see or get something that you looked for
words.example: I can't find my pen.

words.def: a word that says you are able to do something
words.example: I can swim, but I can't play the guitar.

questions.explanation: Want — хотеть (*I want a new phone*). Need — нуждаться, like — нравиться, take — брать.
Know — знать (*I don't know*). Think — думать, see — видеть, say — сказать.
Give — давать. Take — наоборот, брать; get — получать; have — иметь.
Find — находить (*I can't find my pen*). Look — смотреть, use — использовать, come — приходить.

questions.text: Выберите слово, подходящее в предложение: I ___ breakfast at 7.
questions.explanation: Have breakfast — завтракать. С едой англичане говорят have: *have lunch, have dinner*.

questions.text: Выберите слово, подходящее в предложение: We ___ to school every day.
questions.explanation: Go to school — ходить в школу. Go — это движение из одного места в другое.

questions.text: Выберите слово, подходящее в предложение: I ___ my homework in the evening.
questions.explanation: Говорят *do homework* — делать домашнее задание. Make — это создать что-то новое: *make tea, make a cake*.
Say — сказать (*say hello*). Look — смотреть, think — думать, know — знать.

questions.text: Выберите слово, подходящее в предложение: Yesterday I ___ to the cinema.
questions.explanation: Yesterday — вчера, значит нужно прошедшее время. Go — неправильный глагол: go → **went**.
Can — мочь, уметь (*I can swim*). После can глагол идёт без to: *I can speak English*.
